name: hellfire spellcasting
desc: The pit fiend casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Fireball} (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @abilities.cha.dc]]).. It can replace one Fireball with @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHoldMonste]{Hold Monster} (level 7 version) or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWallofFire]{Wall of Fire}.
